mainEntity.name: How do I calculate hours worked with a lunch break?

acceptedAnswer.text: Subtract the clock-in time from the clock-out time and then subtract the unpaid break. From 8:30 to 17:15 with a 45 minute lunch is 8 hours 45 minutes minus 45 minutes, which is 8.00 hours.

mainEntity.name: How do I turn minutes into a decimal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the minutes by 60. Fifteen minutes is 0.25 hours, 30 minutes is 0.50, 45 minutes is 0.75 and 20 minutes is 0.33 hours.
Under federal law, non-exempt employees earn at least 1.5 times their regular rate for hours over 40 in a workweek. Some states also count hours over 8 in a day. Choose the rule that applies to you.

It is a common way of rounding time clocks to the nearest quarter hour: punches 1 to 7 minutes past a quarter round down and 8 to 14 minutes round up. Rounding is allowed if it averages out fairly over time.
